integrity: Analytic argument with an independently formulated exact-rational finite checker; finite checks are corroborative, not a proof. Earliest date from original reference recording a public society presentation in 1946; publication occurred in 1949.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary interval BV to unweighted L2 in standard Paley order; no global subspace minimax or other Walsh orderings. Classical priority cannot be certified exhaustively.
title: Exact all-cutoff bounded-variation error of Walsh-Paley orthogonal projections
